note: No without-skill baseline is run: the pipeline this skill drives (the splatsite CLI, the scene manifest format, the splat stage device) is not discoverable by an agent that has not read the skill, so a baseline run measures nothing but that absence.

evals.name: bespoke-scroll-page-from-scene
evals.prompt: I've got a 3D capture of a small street food stall that I filmed on my phone — the converted scene folder is at <scene>. Build me an interactive scrolling website around it. It's for a food truck brand called Ember & Ash; visitors should end up wanting to come find the truck. Use your judgment on the creative direction, I want to get out of your way.
evals.expected_output: A brief marked as authored, a built site whose fixed world is the capture, acts that fly the camera plus at least three non-splat device families, and a passing splatsite check.
assertions: The build contains index.html, scene.json, splat-stage.js and vendor/ (stage-init was used rather than hand-rolled plumbing)
splatsite check on the built site exits 0 with count > 0 and coverage >= 0.2
The page mounts the scroll-craft engine and at least three acts use a device family other than the camera
A BRIEF.md exists and is marked as authored rather than interviewed
No image or video generation API was called

evals.name: template-route-photo-walk
evals.prompt: I walked through our community sports ground filming on my phone and took photos at a few spots along the way. I want a page where visitors walk the ground and see each photo where I took it. The capture is already converted at <scene> — I don't have separate photo files, just use a few frames from the capture as the photos.
evals.expected_output: The template route chosen and stated, manifest spots edited with photos, splatsite build run, and a passing check. A bespoke page here would be the wrong call.
assertions: The skill's template route was chosen and the choice was stated in one sentence
splatsite build produced the site (the album markup is present in index.html)
The scene manifest has at least two spots, each with at least one photo that exists in the photos directory
splatsite check on the built site exits 0 with count > 0 and coverage >= 0.2
